mapper.select: select id, username, email, password_hash, display_name, role_id, enabled, must_change_password from sys_user where username = #{username} and deleted = 0 limit 1
select id, username, email, password_hash, display_name, role_id, enabled, must_change_password from sys_user where id = #{userId} and deleted = 0 limit 1
select r.code from sys_role r inner join sys_user u on u.role_id = r.id where u.id = #{userId} order by r.sort_order asc, r.id asc
select distinct p.code from sys_permission p inner join sys_role_permission rp on rp.permission_id = p.id inner join sys_user u on u.role_id = rp.role_id where u.id = #{userId} order by p.code asc
select id, title, name, path, component, icon, permission_code, keep_alive, parent_id, sort_order from sys_menu where menu_scope = #{menuScope} order by sort_order asc, id asc
mapper.insert: insert into sys_refresh_token ( token, user_id, expires_at, revoked, created_at ) values ( #{token}, #{userId}, #{expiresAt}, 0, now() )
mapper.select: select token, user_id, expires_at, revoked from sys_refresh_token where token = #{token} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into sys_user (id, username, email, password_hash, display_name, role_id, enabled, must_change_password, deleted, created_at) values (#{id}, #{username}, #{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{displayName}, #{roleId}, 0, 0, 0, now())

select id, username, display_name from sys_user where enabled = 1 and deleted = 0 order by display_name asc, username asc, id asc
mapper.update: update sys_user set enabled = #{enabled} where id = #{userId} and deleted = 0
